tools.name: list_public_artworks
tools.description: Browse the public AirGallery discover feed. Returns artworks with image URLs, prompts, tags, and creator info. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Get details of a specific artwork by ID including image URL, prompt, tags, and metadata.

tools.name: list_my_artworks
tools.description: List the authenticated user's saved artworks (private gallery). Requires auth.

tools.name: save_artwork
tools.description: Save an artwork to the authenticated user's gallery. A data:image URI (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF) is uploaded to AirGallery storage and the artwork stores the resulting public URL; http(s) URLs are stored as given. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: delete_artwork
tools.description: Delete an artwork from the authenticated user's gallery. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's current credit balance. Requires auth.

tools.name: get_credit_costs
tools.description: Get the credit cost for each AI tool operation. No auth required.

tools.name: get_pricing_tiers
tools.description: Get available credit purchase tiers and prices. No auth required.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove the background from an image, leaving the subject on transparency. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: enhance_image
tools.description: Enhance image quality: general clean-up, sharpen, denoise or fix lighting. Returns { image }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale an image 1–6x with Topaz Gigapixel AI. Returns { image }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: text_to_image
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with a style and aspect ratio. Returns { generatedImage }. Cost: 3 credits. For a choice of image models use create_image.

tools.name: ai_replace
tools.description: Replace a marked area of an image with something described in words. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: ai_expand
tools.description: Expand (outpaint) an image beyond its borders. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: object_remover
tools.description: Erase marked objects from an image and fill the space naturally. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: colorize_image
tools.description: Colorize a black and white photograph. Returns { image }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: cartoonize
tools.description: Turn a photo into a cartoon. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: style_transfer
tools.description: Repaint a content image in the style of a second, style reference image. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: relight_image
tools.description: Change the lighting of an image. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: dslr_transform
tools.description: Make a phone photo look like it was taken with a DSLR camera. Returns { image }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: photo_repair
tools.description: Fix blur, noise, low resolution or general damage in a photo. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: old_photo_restore
tools.description: Restore an old photograph: scratches, fading, stains, creases. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: ai_filters
tools.description: Apply an artistic AI filter to an image. Returns { image }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: retro_transform
tools.description: Apply a retro look to an image. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: polaroid_transform
tools.description: Turn an image into a Polaroid instant print. Returns { image }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: headshot_generator
tools.description: Generate a professional headshot from a selfie. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: portrait_retouch
tools.description: Retouch a portrait naturally. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: avatar_generator
tools.description: Generate a stylized avatar from a face photo. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: meme_generator
tools.description: Add classic top/bottom meme captions to an image. At least one caption is required. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 1 credit.

tools.name: product_studio
tools.description: Turn a product photo into a styled e-commerce shot. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: logo_mockup
tools.description: Place a logo on a realistic merchandise or signage mockup. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: poster_generator
tools.description: Design a poster from a description. Returns { generatedImage }. Cost: 3 credits.

tools.name: aspect_ratio_change
tools.description: Change an image's aspect ratio, filling new space with AI. Returns { processedImage }. Cost: 2 credits.

tools.name: generate_tags
tools.description: Generate 5–8 descriptive tags for an image. Returns { tags }. Cost: 1 credit; free the first time for one of your own saved artworks that has no tags yet.

tools.description: Create or transform an image using AirGallery's core multi-modal image pipeline (powers the Create page). tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile (username, bio, avatar). Requires auth.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's profile (username, bio, avatar_url). Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a public user profile by user ID.

tools.name: follow_user
tools.description: Follow another user. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: unfollow_user
tools.description: Unfollow a user. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: like_artwork
tools.description: Like a public artwork. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: unlike_artwork
tools.description: Remove a like from an artwork. Requires auth + 'write' scope.

tools.name: list_my_white_label_galleries
tools.description: List the authenticated user's white-label galleries. Requires auth.

tools.name: get_white_label_gallery
tools.description: Get a public white-label gallery by slug.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_image" is 724 chars, far longer than this server's median (88). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Create or transform an image using AirGallery's core multi-modal image pipeline (powers the Create page). Accepts up to 5 reference images plus a custom prompt …

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_pricing_tiers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get available credit purchase tiers and prices. Requires auth." → after: "Get available credit purchase tiers and prices. No auth required."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
